description: Simple SOC-voltage model: V = OCV(SOC) - I*R_internal

cell.name: Generic high-temperature NaS cell (NGK PS-class T~320 C)
cell.source: Wen, Z. et al. (2008), Mater. Sci. Eng. B 154-155, 73; NGK Insulators NAS battery technical brochure

internal_resistance.note: Approximate DC resistance per cell at 320 C, 50% SOC

operating_temperature_C.note: Required to keep Na and S molten and beta-alumina conductive

ocv_coefficients.description: OCV(SOC) polynomial fit: OCV = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 + a4*SOC^4 + a5*SOC^5
ocv_coefficients.source: Polynomial fit to representative NaS discharge curve (two-plateau, 1.78-2.08 V)

temperature.note: F1a ignores temperature effects but cell only works in this window
